tools.name: -health-check
tools.description: Internal health check tool. Verifies Linear API key and connectivity.

tools.name: linear-list-issues
tools.description: List Linear issues with optional filters. Returns curated rows { id, identifier, title, url, status, priority, assignee, team, createdAt, updatedAt }. Params: teamId?, status?, assigneeId?, priority?, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

startCursor.description: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear issue nodes. Default false.

tools.name: linear-get-issue
tools.description: Retrieve a Linear issue by UUID or identifier (e.g. "TER-123"). Returns curated { id, identifier, title, url, status, priority, assignee, team, project, cycle, labels, description, createdAt, updatedAt }. Params: issueId, descriptionFormat ('full' | 'summary', default 'full'), fields?, includeRaw.

descriptionFormat.description: Control description size. 'full' (default) returns the complete markdown; 'summary' truncates to 500 chars and adds descriptionTruncated=true. Useful when scanning issues for context size.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear issue object. Default false.

tools.name: linear-create-issue
tools.description: Create a Linear issue. Returns curated { id, identifier, title, url, status, priority, assignee, team, createdAt, updatedAt }. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: title, teamId, description?, assigneeId?, priority?, projectId?, labelIds?, stateId?, parentId? (UUID or "TER-123"), fields?, includeRaw.

labelIds.description: Label UUIDs to attach on creation.

stateId.description: Workflow state UUID to set initially.

parentId.description: Parent issue UUID or identifier (e.g. "TER-123"). Only set when creating a sub-task; omit otherwise.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned issue.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear issue object. Default false.

tools.name: linear-update-issue
tools.description: Update a Linear issue. Returns curated updated issue. Idempotent per-field — safe to retry. Params: issueId, title?, description?, stateId?, assigneeId?, priority?, projectId?, labelIds?, estimate?, dueDate?, fields?, includeRaw.

labelIds.description: Full label-id set (overwrites). Use add/remove-labels-to-issue for delta.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned issue.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear issue object. Default false.

tools.name: linear-delete-issue
tools.description: Permanently delete a Linear issue. Irreversible. Returns { success, issueId }.

tools.name: linear-archive-issue
tools.description: Archive a Linear issue (soft delete). Reversible via un-archive. Returns { success, issueId }.

tools.name: linear-add-comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a Linear issue. Returns curated { id, body, authorId, authorName, issueId, url, createdAt }. Not retryable. Params: issueId, body, fields?, includeRaw.

body.description: Markdown comment body. Must not be empty.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear comment object. Default false.

tools.name: linear-list-projects
tools.description: List Linear projects. Returns curated rows { id, name, url, state, icon, color, progress, startDate, targetDate, createdAt, updatedAt }. Params: teamId?, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

startCursor.description: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear project nodes. Default false.

tools.name: linear-create-project
tools.description: Create a Linear project. Returns curated project shape. Not retryable (no idempotency key). Params: name, teamIds, description?, leadId?, startDate?, targetDate?, fields?, includeRaw.

teamIds.description: Team UUIDs that own this project.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned project.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear project object. Default false.

tools.name: linear-delete-project
tools.description: Permanently delete a Linear project. Irreversible. Issues in the project become detached (not deleted). Returns { success, projectId }.

tools.name: linear-add-issues-to-project
tools.description: Attach one or more Linear issues to a project. Returns { projectId, added, failed, results: [{ issueId, identifier?, success, error? }] }.

tools.name: linear-remove-issues-from-project
tools.description: Detach one or more Linear issues from their project. Returns { removed, failed, results: [{ issueId, identifier?, success, error? }] }.

issueIds.description: Issue UUIDs or identifiers to detach.

tools.name: linear-list-labels
tools.description: List Linear labels. Returns curated rows { id, name, color, description, isGroup, parentId }. Params: teamId?, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

startCursor.description: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear label nodes. Default false.

tools.name: linear-create-label
tools.description: Create a Linear label. Returns curated { id, name, color, description }. Not retryable. Params: name, teamId, color?, description?, fields?, includeRaw.

teamId.description: Team UUID that owns the label.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned label.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear label object. Default false.

tools.name: linear-update-label
tools.description: Update a Linear label. Returns curated updated label. Idempotent per-field. Params: labelId, name?, color?, description?, fields?, includeRaw.

fields.description: Override default whitelist on the returned label.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear label object. Default false.

tools.name: linear-delete-label
tools.description: Permanently delete a Linear label. Irreversible. Returns { success, labelId }.

tools.name: linear-add-labels-to-issue
tools.description: Add labels to a Linear issue (deduped server-side against existing labels). Returns { issueId, added, total, labelIds }.

tools.name: linear-remove-labels-from-issue
tools.description: Remove labels from a Linear issue. Returns { issueId, removed, total, labelIds }.

tools.name: linear-list-teams
tools.description: List Linear teams. Returns curated rows { id, name, key, icon, color, description, private }. Params: limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

startCursor.description: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear team nodes. Default false.

tools.name: linear-list-users
tools.description: List Linear workspace users. Optionally filters by team membership. Returns curated rows { id, name, displayName, email, avatarUrl, active, admin }. Params: teamId?, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

teamId.description: Filter by team UUID (returns members of that team only).

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

startCursor.description: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear user nodes. Default false.

tools.name: linear-list-workflow-states
tools.description: List workflow states for a team. Returns curated rows { id, name, type, color, position, description }. Params: teamId, limit (1-100, def 50), startCursor, fields?, includeRaw.

limit.description: Results per page. Min 1, max 100, default 50.

startCursor.description: Linear relay cursor from previous response.nextCursor.

includeRaw.description: Return raw Linear state nodes. Default false.
